vocab.m: hiệu quả, tiết kiệm nguồn lực

quiz.q: You are opening a meeting with foreign partners. Which line sounds most natural and professional?
o: Thanks for joining. Let's start with a quick look at the agenda.
Okay, we start now. Listen to me.
Hello. Meeting is begin.
quiz.why: Thank people for coming, then move to the agenda. That is the standard way to open.

quiz.q: You didn't catch the number your partner just said.
o: Sorry, could you repeat the last figure?
What? Say again.
You speak too fast.
quiz.why: "Could you repeat..." is polite and says exactly what you need again.

quiz.q: Introduce your role.
o: I'm in charge of sales administration and key accounts.
I am charge sales admin.
My job is do the sales.
quiz.why: Use "be in charge of + noun".

quiz.q: You want someone to write the official record of the meeting.
o: Could you take the minutes today?
Could you speak the minutes today?
You write the meeting for me.
quiz.why: "Take the minutes" means to write the official record of a meeting.

quiz.q: The meeting is ending. How do you make sure everyone knows their tasks?
o: Let's recap the action items and who owns each one.
I think everybody knows already.
Okay, we finish now. Goodbye.
quiz.why: Recap the action items and the owners at the end of every meeting.

quiz.q: "Follow up" means…
o: contact someone again or check progress
go behind someone
finish a meeting early
quiz.why: To follow up is to check again on something you started earlier.
